headline: Saclag, Alvarez Assure Philippines of Two Asian Games MMA Medals
seoTitle: Saclag, Alvarez Secure at Least Bronze in Asian Games MMA | FMB News
seoDescription: Jean Claude Saclag and Carlos Alvarez reached the Asian Games MMA semifinals, assuring the Philippines of at least two bronze medals in the sport's Games debut.
deck: Jean Claude Saclag and Carlos Alvarez won their quarterfinal bouts at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center, guaranteeing the Philippines at least two bronze medals as mixed martial arts makes its Asian Games debut.
author: FMB News Sports Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Filipino mixed martial artists Jean Claude Saclag and Carlos Alvarez advanced to the semifinals of their respective divisions at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, assuring Team Philippines of at least two additional bronze medals.

Saclag defeated Saudi Arabia's Saud Fawaz Almolhem in the men's traditional -65kg quarterfinal. Alvarez followed with a knockout of Indonesia's Ananda Wahyu Setyo in the men's traditional -77kg quarterfinal.

sections.heading: What is confirmed
paragraphs: Philstar, GMA News, the Philippine Daily Inquirer and BusinessMirror independently reported the two quarterfinal victories and the resulting guaranteed medals. Their reports include material and athlete comments from the Philippine Olympic Committee media operation.

The Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games Organising Committee confirms that mixed martial arts is being contested at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center from September 20 to 22, with the September 21 session covering the next stage before the September 22 medal finals.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Mixed martial arts is making its Asian Games debut in Aichi-Nagoya. Saclag is a former Asian Games wushu silver medalist and a multiple SEA Games kickboxing champion, while Alvarez has competed professionally in ONE Championship.
Gina Araos, the Philippines' third MMA entrant, was eliminated by Thailand's Kanjutha Phattaraboonsorn in the women's modern -54kg division.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The victories guarantee the Philippines two more medals after the women's soft tennis team delivered the country's first medal of these Games. Saclag and Alvarez remain in contention to upgrade those guaranteed bronzes by advancing to the finals.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Saclag is scheduled to face Tajikistan's Otabek Rajabov in the -65kg semifinal on September 21. Alvarez also advances to the -77kg semifinal. The MMA finals are scheduled for September 22.

verificationNotes: Philstar's on-site report identifies Saclag's quarterfinal opponent as Saudi Arabia's Saud Fawaz Almolhem and Alvarez's opponent as Indonesia's Ananda Wahyu Setyo, and reports both victories as guaranteeing bronze medals.
GMA News, INQUIRER.net and BusinessMirror independently corroborate that Saclag and Alvarez advanced and are assured of medals.
The Aichi-Nagoya organising committee's official venue page confirms MMA competition at Nagoya City Inae Sports Center on September 20-22, 2026.
No claim is made that either athlete has already won a semifinal or final; the medals are described as guaranteed minimum bronzes pending later rounds.
The contextual venue photograph is KKPCW's own work on Wikimedia Commons under CC BY-SA 4.0 and is explicitly labeled as a 2020 file photograph rather than an image of the current bouts.
